coder_notes: GBM named only in Phase 1a inclusion notes (not in conditions/title); basket per D27B. GBM patients can enter Phase 1a only (monotherapy Part 1 or pembrolizumab combination Part 2); Phase 1b cohorts are NSCLC, MSS-CRC, sarcoma, uveal melanoma. DCSZ11 is monotherapy in 'Phase 1a Dose Escalation Monotherapy' and combination elsewhere; coded experimental_combination overall. Trial regimen coded combination because most experimental arms combine; GBM patients may be in either Phase 1a part. Phase 1b SOC arm lists only doxorubicin/tebentafusp as interventions but text says DCSZ11 is given; DCSZ11 arms include it. Paired fresh biopsies (screening + on treatment) with a stated PD objective -> target engagement yes, but GBM/CNS patients are exempt from biopsy. PK sample type not stated. Biomarker rows for the NSCLC/CRC cohorts are absence/cohort requirements, not candidate-matched. An unnamed 'imaging agent' is mentioned in exclusion only; not listed. Quotes with \[ reproduce the record's escaped brackets.
